subject: Staging slot reservation + quote cascade for Q1 onramp
messages:
From: Jordan Lee <procurement@acme.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-02T15:12:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Q1 onramp — staging slot request and OEM quote alignment

Hi Karthik,

We're finalizing our Q1 onboarding window and want to lock a 6-week staging slot in late Jan/early Feb for a Dedicated capacity onramp. Procurement needs a clear delivery window for the NVIDIA SKUs and an explicit fallback to cloud capacity (OmegaCloud) in case OEM shipment slips beyond our acceptance window.

Could you: 1) confirm a tentative staging window and 2) share the latest OEM quote cadence that would trigger the cloud backstop?

Attached: ACME_PO_DRAFT_v1.pdf — our preferred PO template.

Thanks,
Jordan
Jordan Lee
Head of Procurement, AcmeAI
procurement@acme.ai
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <procurement@acme.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-03T09:08:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Q1 onramp — staging slot request and OEM quote alignment

Jordan — thanks for the note and the PO draft. Quick summary of what we can offer and what we'll need from your side to lock dates:

- Tentative staging window: Jan 24 — Mar 6 (6 weeks). We can hold a 2-week soft hold until 2026-11-10 pending an initial deposit on the PO.
- OEM quotes: NVIDIA has a rolling quote cadence; we need a signed acknowledgement by 2026-11-17 to secure the SKU tranche for late-Jan shipments. If that isn't met, default plan is to provision equivalent capacity in OmegaCloud for the first 4 weeks of the onramp and then switch to OEM hardware when available.

Action items for AcmeAI to help us lock this:
- Sign & return PO acknowledgement by 2026-11-17 (we've marked required fields in the attached).
- Confirm whether you accept a staged delivery (partial cloud backstop for weeks 1–4).

Looping Ben for commercial nuance and Laura for onboarding ops. Monica, can you confirm whether the 2-week soft hold is acceptable on our side?

—Karthik
Karthik Iyer
Enterprise Sales Lead, Redwood Inference
From: quotes@nvidia.com <quotes@nvidia.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>
Cc: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, OmegaCloud Sales <sales@omegacloud.com>
Date: 2026-11-04T11:42:00-08:00
Subject: Re: SKU availability — tentative lead times

Karthik,

Per your request, attaching the SKU availability snapshot. Short summary: the Q1 tranche for the requested 4090-class SKUs is currently at a T+10 to T+12 week lead time from PO acceptance for non-prioritized customers. If Redwood can provide a prioritized commitment (firm PO + deposit by 2026-11-17), we can compress to T+6–T+8 weeks under our expedite program, subject to allocation approval.

Attachment: NVIDIA_SKU_QUOTE_Q4.csv (contains per-SKU ETA bands and expedite cost uplift).

Regards,
Nate Hall
Channel Quotes — NVIDIA OEM
quotes@nvidia.com
From: Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-05T08:03:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Q1 onramp — staging slot request and OEM quote alignment

Team — quick operational read:

- If Nvidia's compressed lead time requires a deposit, commercial needs to model both: a) expedite premium vs b) first-4-weeks-cloud-backstop cost. Early calc (very rough): expedite adds ~18% on SKU cost, OmegaCloud backstop burn estimated at $0.14/token-equivalent for the provisional window.
- Laura, can we support a hybrid handover plan where we stand up the staging pool on OmegaCloud for weeks 1–4 and warm the Dedicated nodes as OEM arrives? That keeps Acme's latency expectations for production while we gradually migrate.
- Monica, confirm the 2-week soft hold on our staging calendar and whether ops needs a firm sign-off date earlier than 11/17 to reallocate capacity.

I'll draft a short comparison table we can send to Acme to make the decision straightforward.

Ben Carter
Head of Capacity Planning, Redwood Inference
From: Monica Patel <monica_patel@redwood.ai>
To: Jordan Lee <procurement@acme.ai>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.ai>, Ben Carter <ben_carter@redwood.ai>, Laura Bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.ai>, Vivek Kulkarni <vivek_kulkarni@redwood.ai>
Date: 2026-11-07T10:23:00-08:00
Subject: Re: Q1 onramp — staging slot request and OEM quote alignment

Jordan — following up with concrete ops-level commitments:

1) Soft hold: we've placed a 2-week soft hold on Jan 24 — Mar 6 for Acme. That hold will convert to a firm reservation if we receive PO acknowledgement + 25% deposit by 2026-11-17.
2) Hybrid onramp: We can provision a warm staging pool on OmegaCloud for the first 4 weeks (configuration parity with Dedicated), with a phased migration plan to OEM hardware as kits arrive. Migration window will be coordinated via a two-week cutover; during cutover we'll run mirrored traffic and a final cache sync.
3) Costs & fallbacks: see attached proposed-staging-calendar.xlsx and a one-page cost comparison we'll send to Acme tomorrow.

Jordan — if you can confirm acceptance of the hybrid approach and the deposit cadence, we'll circulate the cost table and a DocuSign PO link for signature.

Thanks,
Monica Patel
Program Manager, Onboarding Operations — Redwood Inference
Monica.Patel@redwood.ai
